row: Located in Keizer, Oregon and serving the larger Salem area, the leading health professionals at Back to Health Clinic are dedicated to helping you achieve your wellness objectives -- combining skill and expertise that spans the entire chiropractic wellness spectrum. Dr. Jeff Baker is committed to bringing you better health and a better way of life by teaching and practicing the true principles of chiropractic wellness care.
